values: 一名擅长使用祷告的游侠，擅长针对具有回复能力的敌人。
A devout Rogue, relentless in hunting down enemies with healing powers.
The time has come to depart.
Perhaps... the answer lies within these pages.
送给我？太好了……我很喜欢。
For me, truly? I adore it.
My thanks. I hope it wasn't too great an inconvenience.
辉光下的猎手，追随本心的誓言一路前行。
A hunter walking in the light, guided by nothing but a promise.
卸下重担，拥抱夏日烈阳。
Leave your worries behind and soak in the summer sunshine.
The aroma of this drink dulls my sense of smell...
一碗热汤，不要过度烹饪
This place is radiant and inviting...
Let's make the most of this celebration.
法拉莫尔的故乡曽爆发过一场由亡灵引发的污染异变。由于这场异变，故乡的土地被污染破坏，许多亲友身亡。法拉莫尔也因此离家，踏上了寻找真相、追踪凶手的旅程。
Faramor's homeland was ravaged by a Graveborn-induced anomaly, destroying the land and claiming many lives. This tragedy led him to leave and pursue the truth, determined to find the culprit.
循着亡灵的线索，法拉莫尔一路追查到白山公国。他在这里接触到了“亡灵猎人”这个来自耀光帝国的神秘组织，并成为了组织中第一位绿裔猎人。
Tracing the Graveborn's trail, Faramor arrived at Whiteridge, where he joined the "undead hunters", a secret group from the Lightbearer Empire. He was its first Wilder member.
法拉莫尔为手中所持的圣典起名为“辉光之书”，这是他自己整理制作的，几乎一切有关亡灵的知识都能在其中找到。
He named his sacred tome the "Book of Radiance". It contains nearly all known knowledge about the undead and the Graveborn.
法拉莫尔温柔、善良，有着出众的礼仪风度，也很注重自己的外表。在他看来，将毛发打理得干净、顺滑和整洁，也是一种礼貌的象征。
Faramor is gentle and kind, and he possesses exceptional etiquette and composure. He places high importance on keeping his fur clean and well-groomed.
对法拉莫尔来说，极其出色的嗅觉既是天赋，也是折磨。毕竟，没人喜欢隔着几百米就闻到令人不悦的气味。
His heightened sense of smell is both a gift and a burden. After all, no one enjoys detecting unpleasant odors from hundreds of meters away.
“法拉莫尔？我当然知道他啦！他很温柔，会炖好喝的汤，还会给我讲他家乡的故事！啊，他还会害羞呢，真的！他害羞的时候耳朵会发红，还会轻轻地抖动，我见过的！”——雪松镇的孩子。
"Faramor? Oh, I know him! He's super nice, makes yummy soup, and tells the best stories about his home! He even gets all shy sometimes. His ears turn red and wiggle!" —A child from Cedartown
身为一名绿裔，法拉莫尔对植物有着天生的好感，对草药配制也颇有心得。除此之外，他还很擅长制作一种保养毛发的油膏。
As a Wilder, Faramor has a natural affinity for plants and is skilled in herbal remedies. He also invented a special ointment for fur care.
在家乡时，法拉莫尔和其他绿裔一样使用自然之力战斗。但在成为亡灵猎人后，他开始针对性地学习圣光力量，并逐渐将两者结合，创造了一套属于自己的战斗方式。
Back in his homeland, Faramor, like other Wilders, fought using the power of nature. Now, as an undead hunter, he combines that with Divine Light, creating his own unique combat style.
法拉莫尔的武器在家乡异变中损毁。后来，他用蕴含光辉力量的材料亲手锻造了一把新的十字刃，并从已损毁的旧武器上取了部分材料制作成新武器的剑柄。

After his original weapon was destroyed in the catastrophe in his homeland, Faramor forged a new blade, incorporating materials imbued with the power of light and parts of his old weapon into the hilt.
法拉莫尔为自己的新武器起名为“誓言之心”，以提醒自己不要忘记自己曾立下的誓言——亲手将引发家乡异变的亡灵缉捕归案。
Faramor named his weapon "Oathheart" as a reminder never to forget the vow he made—to personally capture the Graveborn responsible for his homeland's devastation.
法拉莫尔先生，祭典结束以后，你会一直留在雪松镇吗？
Mr. Faramor, will you be staying in Cedartown after the festival is over?
漫漫 & 法拉莫尔 & 满满
这本书里记录了一些古老的咒语，使用了诸神时代的圣书文字，有几个字我实在无法辨认。
This book of ancient spells is written in the language of the old gods' era. There are some characters I can't recognize.
真没想到，白山的活死人竟然是死神大人为了对抗恶魔而创造的亡灵战士。
The undead here are actually warriors created to subdue the Hypogeans—who'd have known?
夕菊、异香草、橙花、响铃花的种子……
Evening chrysanthemums, aromagrass, orange blossoms, and bellflower seeds...
嗬！一位狼兄弟！要不要和我来一场决斗？
Oh, a fellow wolf! Care to duel me?
